name: Test and lint
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

jobs:
  check:
    name: Test and lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Node setup
        uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version: "24.x"
          cache: "npm"
          cache-dependency-path: package-lock.json

      - name: Install and build
        run: |
          npm ci
          npm run build
      - name: Test
        run: |
          npm test
          npm run typecheck
          npm run lint

  integration:
    name: Integration on a real backend
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Node setup
        uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version: "24.x"
          cache: "npm"
          cache-dependency-path: package-lock.json

      - name: Install and build
        run: |
          npm ci
          npm run build
      - name: Integration
        run: npm run test:integration

# Runs the contract suite against the latest stable Langfuse release, outside
# the pull request gate. It records the release and its image digests in the
# job summary and an artifact; a failure shows as this failed run. It never
# changes contract/supported.json.
name: Langfuse latest
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "17 5 * * 1"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  latest:
    name: Contract on the latest Langfuse
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 40

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Node setup
        uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version: "24.x"
          cache: "npm"
          cache-dependency-path: package-lock.json

      # The highest stable release tag `vX.Y.Z`, its commit and the digests
      # of its web and worker images. The other images stay those of the
      # first entry of contract/supported.json.
      - name: Resolve the latest stable release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          tag=$(gh api --paginate 'repos/langfuse/langfuse/releases?per_page=100' \
            --jq '.[] | select(.draft == false and .prerelease == false) | .tag_name' |
            grep -E '^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$' | sort -V | tail -n1)
          test -n "$tag"
          version=${tag#v}
          commit=$(gh api "repos/langfuse/langfuse/commits/$tag" --jq .sha)
          digest() {
            docker buildx imagetools inspect "$1" --format '{{json .Manifest}}' | jq -r .digest
          }
          web="langfuse/langfuse:$version@$(digest "langfuse/langfuse:$version")"
          worker="langfuse/langfuse-worker:$version@$(digest "langfuse/langfuse-worker:$version")"
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/latest"
          jq --arg version "$version" --arg commit "$commit" \
            --arg web "$web" --arg worker "$worker" \
            '{stacks: [.stacks[0]
              | .langfuse = $version
              | .source = "https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/tree/\($commit)"
              | .images.web = $web
              | .images.worker = $worker]}' \
            contract/supported.json > "$RUNNER_TEMP/latest/stack.json"
          {
            echo "## Latest stable Langfuse: $tag"
            echo
            echo "- Commit: \`$commit\`"
            echo "- Web: \`$web\`"
            echo "- Worker: \`$worker\`"
            echo
            echo '```json'
            cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/latest/stack.json"
            echo '```'
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

      - name: Upload the resolved stack
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: langfuse-latest-stack
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/latest/stack.json

      - name: Install and build
        run: |
          npm ci
          npm run build

      - name: Contract suite
        run: npm run test:contract -- --stack "$RUNNER_TEMP/latest/stack.json"

      - name: Upload logs
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: contract-logs-latest
          path: contract/logs/
          if-no-files-found: ignore

      - name: Remove leftover stacks
        if: always()
        run: |
          docker compose ls --all --format json |
            jq -r '.[].Name | select(startswith("convex-langfuse-contract-"))' |
            xargs -r -I{} docker compose -p {} down --volumes --remove-orphans

# Runs the load, outage, backlog threshold and prompt refresh drivers of
# `integration/load.mjs`, each on a runner of its own. They measure latency
# and rates, so they need an idle machine. Started by hand only: the longest
# driver takes about 17 minutes.
name: Load drivers

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  load:
    name: Driver
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        driver: ["load", "outage", "threshold", "threshold --kill", "prompts"]

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Node setup
        uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version: "24.x"
          cache: "npm"
          cache-dependency-path: package-lock.json

      - name: Install and build
        run: |
          npm ci
          npm run build

      # The driver and its option are two words on purpose.
      - name: Run the driver
        env:
          DRIVER: ${{ matrix.driver }}
        run: node integration/load.mjs $DRIVER --out load-results.json

      - name: Upload the results
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: load-results-${{ strategy.job-index }}
          path: load-results.json
          if-no-files-found: ignore

name: Release

# Publishes the package to npm when a tag `v<version>` is pushed, through npm
# trusted publishing: the publish job proves its identity with a GitHub OIDC
# token, so no npm token is stored anywhere. The trusted publisher on npm
# names this file and the environment `npm`.

on:
  push:
    tags: ["v*"]

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: npm-release
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  pack:
    name: Test and pack
    if: github.repository == 'stickerdaniel/convex-langfuse'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    outputs:
      version: ${{ steps.pack.outputs.version }}
      sha256: ${{ steps.pack.outputs.sha256 }}
      publish: ${{ steps.pack.outputs.publish }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Node setup
        uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version: "24.x"
          cache: "npm"
          cache-dependency-path: package-lock.json

      - name: Test
        run: |
          npm ci
          npm run build
          npm test
          npm run typecheck
          npm run lint

      - name: Pack and check
        id: pack
        env:
          OUT: ${{ runner.temp }}/release
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          fail() { echo "::error::$1"; exit 1; }
          version="$(jq -r .version package.json)"
          [ "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" = "v$version" ] || fail "Tag $GITHUB_REF_NAME does not name version $version."
          # npm publishes a prerelease only with an explicit dist-tag.
          [[ "$version" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]] || fail "Only stable versions are released."
          # A clean build: a leftover build info file makes tsc skip files.
          rm -rf dist ./*.tsbuildinfo
          mkdir -p "$OUT"
          npm pack --pack-destination "$OUT" > /dev/null
          mv "$OUT"/*.tgz "$OUT/package.tgz"
          tar -tzf "$OUT/package.tgz" > "$OUT/files.txt"
          manifest="$(tar -xOzf "$OUT/package.tgz" package/package.json)"
          [ "$(jq -r .name <<<"$manifest")" = "@stickerdaniel/convex-langfuse" ] || fail "Unexpected package name."
          [ "$(jq -r .version <<<"$manifest")" = "$version" ] || fail "Tarball version differs."
          # Every file the exports map names is in the tarball.
          for file in $(jq -r '.exports | .. | strings' <<<"$manifest" | sort -u); do
            grep -qx "package/${file#./}" "$OUT/files.txt" || fail "The tarball lacks $file."
          done
          ! grep -E '\.test(-d|-util)?\.ts$' "$OUT/files.txt" || fail "The tarball holds test files."
          # A consumer installs the tarball and loads both runtime entries,
          # which load every file they import. The install resolves the
          # dependency ranges from the registry, as a consumer's does. Each
          # command ends the subshell itself: `||` on it turns off `set -e`.
          smoke="$RUNNER_TEMP/smoke"
          mkdir -p "$smoke"
          (
            cd "$smoke" || exit 1
            npm init -y > /dev/null || exit 1
            npm install --no-audit --no-fund --ignore-scripts "$OUT/package.tgz" > /dev/null || exit 1
            node --input-type=module -e 'await import("@stickerdaniel/convex-langfuse"); await import("@stickerdaniel/convex-langfuse/ids");'
          ) || fail "The installed tarball does not load."
          status="$(curl --silent --show-error --retry 3 --max-time 30 --output /dev/null \
            --write-out '%{http_code}' "https://registry.npmjs.org/@stickerdaniel%2fconvex-langfuse/$version")"
          case "$status" in
            200) publish=false; echo "Version $version is already on npm." ;;
            404) publish=true ;;
            *) fail "npm lookup answered HTTP $status." ;;
          esac
          {
            echo "version=$version"
            echo "sha256=$(sha256sum "$OUT/package.tgz" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
            echo "publish=$publish"
          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: npm-package
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release/package.tgz
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

  publish:
    name: Publish to npm
    needs: pack
    if: needs.pack.outputs.publish == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    environment:
      name: npm
      url:
        https://www.npmjs.com/package/@stickerdaniel/convex-langfuse/v/${{
        needs.pack.outputs.version }}
    permissions:
      id-token: write
    steps:
      # This job holds the publishing identity and runs no repository code.
      - name: Node setup
        uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version: "24.x"
          registry-url: https://registry.npmjs.org

      - name: Require npm with trusted publishing
        run: printf '11.5.1\n%s\n' "$(npm --version)" | sort -V -C

      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: npm-package
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release

      - name: Publish the tested tarball
        env:
          TARBALL: ${{ runner.temp }}/release/package.tgz
          SHA256: ${{ needs.pack.outputs.sha256 }}
          VERSION: ${{ needs.pack.outputs.version }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          [ "$(sha256sum "$TARBALL" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$SHA256" ] || { echo "::error::The tarball differs from the tested one."; exit 1; }
          npm publish "$TARBALL" --access public --ignore-scripts
          echo "Published @stickerdaniel/convex-langfuse@$VERSION" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

name: Langfuse contract
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  versions:
    name: Supported Langfuse versions
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    outputs:
      versions: ${{ steps.read.outputs.versions }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - id: read
        run:
          echo "versions=$(jq -c '[.stacks[].langfuse]'
          contract/supported.json)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

  contract:
    name: Contract on Langfuse ${{ matrix.langfuse }}
    needs: versions
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 40
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        langfuse: ${{ fromJSON(needs.versions.outputs.versions) }}

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Node setup
        uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version: "24.x"
          cache: "npm"
          cache-dependency-path: package-lock.json

      - name: Install and build
        run: |
          npm ci
          npm run build

      # Starts the stack, runs the cases, scans the logs for every generated
      # secret and removes the stack. A found secret fails the step and
      # deletes the logs before the upload.
      - name: Contract suite
        env:
          LANGFUSE_VERSION: ${{ matrix.langfuse }}
        run: npm run test:contract -- --langfuse "$LANGFUSE_VERSION"

      - name: Upload logs
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: contract-logs-${{ matrix.langfuse }}
          path: contract/logs/
          if-no-files-found: ignore

      - name: Remove leftover stacks
        if: always()
        run: |
          docker compose ls --all --format json |
            jq -r '.[].Name | select(startswith("convex-langfuse-contract-"))' |
            xargs -r -I{} docker compose -p {} down --volumes --remove-orphans

  faults:
    # GitHub appends the matrix value; a skipped job shows this name as it is.
    name: Fault check
    if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
    needs: versions
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 40
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        langfuse: ${{ fromJSON(needs.versions.outputs.versions) }}

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Node setup
        uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version: "24.x"
          cache: "npm"
          cache-dependency-path: package-lock.json

      - name: Install and build
        run: |
          npm ci
          npm run build

      - name: Fault check
        env:
          LANGFUSE_VERSION: ${{ matrix.langfuse }}
        run: npm run test:contract:faults -- --langfuse "$LANGFUSE_VERSION"

      - name: Upload logs
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: contract-fault-logs-${{ matrix.langfuse }}
          path: contract/logs/
          if-no-files-found: ignore

      - name: Remove leftover stacks
        if: always()
        run: |
          docker compose ls --all --format json |
            jq -r '.[].Name | select(startswith("convex-langfuse-contract-"))' |
            xargs -r -I{} docker compose -p {} down --volumes --remove-orphans

{
  "name": "@stickerdaniel/convex-langfuse",
  "description": "Export LLM traces and scores from a Convex app to Langfuse through a transactional outbox, with a prompt cache.",
  "repository": {
    "type": "git",
    "url": "git+https://github.com/stickerdaniel/convex-langfuse.git"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/stickerdaniel/convex-langfuse#readme",
  "bugs": {
    "url": "https://github.com/stickerdaniel/convex-langfuse/issues"
  },
  "version": "0.2.0",
  "license": "Apache-2.0",
  "keywords": [
    "convex",
    "component",
    "langfuse",
    "observability",
    "llm",
    "opentelemetry",
    "tracing",
    "ai"
  ],
  "type": "module",
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "run-p -r 'dev:*'",
    "dev:backend": "convex dev --typecheck-components",
    "dev:frontend": "cd example && vite --clearScreen false",
    "dev:build": "chokidar 'tsconfig*.json' 'src/**/*.ts' -i '**/*.test.ts' -c 'npm run build:codegen' --initial",
    "predev": "path-exists .env.local dist || (npm run build && convex dev --once)",
    "build": "tsc --project ./tsconfig.build.json",
    "build:codegen": "npx convex codegen --component-dir ./src/component && npm run build",
    "build:clean": "rm -rf dist *.tsbuildinfo && npm run build:codegen",
    "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit && tsc -p example && tsc -p example/convex",
    "lint": "eslint .",
    "all": "run-p -r 'dev:*' 'test:watch'",
    "test": "vitest run --typecheck",
    "test:watch": "vitest --typecheck --clearScreen false",
    "test:debug": "vitest --inspect-brk --no-file-parallelism",
    "test:coverage": "vitest run --coverage --coverage.reporter=text",
    "test:integration": "node integration/run.mjs",
    "test:load": "node integration/load.mjs",
    "test:contract": "node contract/run.mjs",
    "test:contract:faults": "node contract/faults.mjs",
    "preversion": "npm install --legacy-peer-deps && npm run build:clean && run-p test lint typecheck",
    "prepack": "node scripts/sync-version.mjs && npm run build",
    "version": "node scripts/sync-version.mjs && git add src/shared/version.ts"
  },
  "files": [
    "dist",
    "src",
    "NOTICE",
    "!src/**/*.test.ts",
    "!src/**/*.test-d.ts",
    "!src/**/*.test-util.ts"
  ],
  "exports": {
    "./package.json": "./package.json",
    ".": {
      "types": "./dist/client/index.d.ts",
      "default": "./dist/client/index.js"
    },
    "./ids": {
      "types": "./dist/shared/ids.d.ts",
      "default": "./dist/shared/ids.js"
    },
    "./test": "./src/test.ts",
    "./_generated/component.js": {
      "types": "./dist/component/_generated/component.d.ts"
    },
    "./_generated/component": {
      "types": "./dist/component/_generated/component.d.ts"
    },
    "./convex.config.js": {
      "types": "./dist/component/convex.config.d.ts",
      "default": "./dist/component/convex.config.js"
    },
    "./convex.config": {
      "types": "./dist/component/convex.config.d.ts",
      "default": "./dist/component/convex.config.js"
    }
  },
  "peerDependencies": {
    "convex": "^1.47.0"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@convex-dev/eslint-plugin": "^5.0.1",
    "@edge-runtime/vm": "^5.0.0",
    "@eslint/eslintrc": "^3.3.5",
    "@eslint/js": "9.39.4",
    "@langfuse/core": "6.1.1",
    "@langfuse/tracing": "6.1.1",
    "@opentelemetry/api": "^1.10.0",
    "@types/node": "^24.12.0",
    "@types/react": "^19.2.14",
    "@types/react-dom": "^19.2.3",
    "@vitejs/plugin-react": "^5.2.0",
    "chokidar-cli": "3.0.0",
    "convex": "1.49.0",
    "convex-test": "0.0.69",
    "eslint": "9.39.4",
    "eslint-plugin-react": "^7.37.5",
    "eslint-plugin-react-hooks": "^7.0.1",
    "eslint-plugin-react-refresh": "^0.5.2",
    "globals": "^17.4.0",
    "npm-run-all2": "8.0.4",
    "path-exists-cli": "2.0.0",
    "pkg-pr-new": "^0.0.66",
    "prettier": "3.8.1",
    "react": "^19.2.4",
    "react-dom": "^19.2.4",
    "typescript": "5.9.3",
    "typescript-eslint": "8.57.1",
    "vite": "7.3.1",
    "vitest": "4.1.0"
  },
  "types": "./dist/client/index.d.ts",
  "module": "./dist/client/index.js",
  "dependencies": {
    "@convex-dev/batch-worker": "^0.3.6"
  },
  "publishConfig": {
    "access": "public"
  }
}

# The Langfuse stack of the contract suite: web, worker, Postgres,
# ClickHouse, Redis and MinIO, plus a relay for the prompt and skill webhooks.
#
# `contract/run.mjs` starts it with a project name of its own per run
# (`docker compose -p`), so every run gets fresh volumes and networks, and
# removes it with `down --volumes`. Every value below comes from the
# environment of that `docker compose` process: the image references from
# `contract/supported.json`, and the keys, passwords and ids, which the runner
# generates per run and never writes to a file. Web and worker publish their
# ports on a free port of 127.0.0.1.
#
# Settings that differ from Langfuse's own compose file:
# - The v4 write mode is set explicitly: `events_only` with the preview
#   opt-in on web and worker, the direct OTLP path on the worker.
# - The organisation, project, API keys and a user are created at boot.
# - Test speed, not processing bounds: no ingestion queue delay, a 100 ms
#   ClickHouse write interval and a 100 ms deletion limiter duration, so a
#   score or trace deletion is applied within a read-back deadline.
# - The webhook relay listens on port 80, the only plain HTTP port Langfuse
#   accepts for a webhook, and forwards to the Convex backend's HTTP actions
#   on the host. `LANGFUSE_WEBHOOK_ALLOWED_HOSTS` lets Langfuse post to its
#   private address. It publishes its record of the deliveries on port 8080
#   of 127.0.0.1.
# - No AI gateway, no telemetry.

x-langfuse-env: &langfuse-env
  NEXTAUTH_URL: http://localhost:3000
  DATABASE_URL: postgresql://postgres:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}@postgres:5432/postgres
  SALT: ${SALT}
  ENCRYPTION_KEY: ${ENCRYPTION_KEY}
  TELEMETRY_ENABLED: "false"
  CLICKHOUSE_MIGRATION_URL: clickhouse://clickhouse:9000
  CLICKHOUSE_URL: http://clickhouse:8123
  CLICKHOUSE_USER: clickhouse
  CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD: [REDACTED]}
  CLICKHOUSE_CLUSTER_ENABLED: "false"
  LANGFUSE_S3_EVENT_UPLOAD_BUCKET: langfuse
  LANGFUSE_S3_EVENT_UPLOAD_REGION: auto
  LANGFUSE_S3_EVENT_UPLOAD_ACCESS_KEY_ID: minio
  LANGFUSE_S3_EVENT_UPLOAD_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: ${MINIO_PASSWORD}
  LANGFUSE_S3_EVENT_UPLOAD_ENDPOINT: http://minio:9000
  LANGFUSE_S3_EVENT_UPLOAD_FORCE_PATH_STYLE: "true"
  LANGFUSE_S3_EVENT_UPLOAD_PREFIX: events/
  REDIS_HOST: redis
  REDIS_PORT: "6379"
  REDIS_AUTH: ${REDIS_PASSWORD}
  LANGFUSE_MIGRATION_V4_WRITE_MODE: events_only
  LANGFUSE_MIGRATION_V4_ALLOW_PREVIEW_OPT_IN: "true"
  LANGFUSE_INGESTION_QUEUE_DELAY_MS: "0"
  LANGFUSE_WEBHOOK_ALLOWED_HOSTS: webhook-relay

x-depends-on-infrastructure: &depends-on-infrastructure
  postgres:
    condition: service_healthy
  clickhouse:
    condition: service_healthy
  redis:
    condition: service_healthy
  minio:
    condition: service_healthy

services:
  langfuse-web:
    image: ${LANGFUSE_WEB_IMAGE}
    depends_on: *depends-on-infrastructure
    ports:
      - 127.0.0.1::3000
    environment:
      <<: *langfuse-env
      # Next.js binds to this address; the default, the container's hostname,
      # leaves 127.0.0.1 unbound for the health check.
      HOSTNAME: 0.0.0.0
      NEXTAUTH_SECRET: [REDACTED]}
      LANGFUSE_INIT_ORG_ID: ${LANGFUSE_INIT_ORG_ID}
      LANGFUSE_INIT_PROJECT_ID: ${LANGFUSE_INIT_PROJECT_ID}
      LANGFUSE_INIT_PROJECT_PUBLIC_KEY: ${LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY}
      LANGFUSE_INIT_PROJECT_SECRET_KEY: ${LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY}
      LANGFUSE_INIT_USER_EMAIL: ${LANGFUSE_USER_EMAIL}
      LANGFUSE_INIT_USER_PASSWORD: [REDACTED]}
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - node
        - -e
        - "fetch('http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/public/health').then((r) =>
          process.exit(r.ok ? 0 : 1), () => process.exit(1))"
      interval: 2s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 300

  langfuse-worker:
    image: ${LANGFUSE_WORKER_IMAGE}
    # The web container runs the migrations; the worker starts after them.
    depends_on:
      langfuse-web:
        condition: service_healthy
    ports:
      - 127.0.0.1::3030
    environment:
      <<: *langfuse-env
      LANGFUSE_MIGRATION_V4_NATIVE_OTEL_BEHAVIOUR: direct
      LANGFUSE_INGESTION_CLICKHOUSE_WRITE_INTERVAL_MS: "100"
      LANGFUSE_CLICKHOUSE_TRACE_DELETION_CONCURRENCY_DURATION_MS: "100"

  webhook-relay:
    # The web image only for its Node runtime, so the stack needs no image
    # besides the pinned ones.
    image: ${LANGFUSE_WEB_IMAGE}
    entrypoint: ["node", "/relay.mjs"]
    ports:
      - 127.0.0.1::8080
    environment:
      RELAY_TARGET: http://host.docker.internal:${CONVEX_SITE_PORT}
    volumes:
      - ./relay.mjs:/relay.mjs:ro
    extra_hosts:
      - host.docker.internal:host-gateway

  postgres:
    image: ${POSTGRES_IMAGE}
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: postgres
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: [REDACTED]}
      POSTGRES_DB: postgres
      TZ: UTC
      PGTZ: UTC
    volumes:
      - postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U postgres"]
      interval: 2s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 60

  clickhouse:
    image: ${CLICKHOUSE_IMAGE}
    user: "101:101"
    environment:
      CLICKHOUSE_DB: default
      CLICKHOUSE_USER: clickhouse
      CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD: [REDACTED]}
    volumes:
      - clickhouse_data:/var/lib/clickhouse
      - clickhouse_logs:/var/log/clickhouse-server
    healthcheck:
      test:
        wget --no-verbose --tries=1 --spider http://localhost:8123/ping || exit
        1
      interval: 2s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 60

  redis:
    image: ${REDIS_IMAGE}
    # The server reads its configuration from stdin, so the password is in
    # the container's environment and not among the server's arguments.
    entrypoint: ["sh", "-c"]
    command:
      - |
        exec redis-server - <<EOF
        requirepass $$REDIS_PASSWORD
        maxmemory-policy noeviction
        EOF
    environment:
      REDIS_PASSWORD: [REDACTED]}
    volumes:
      - redis_data:/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 2s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 60

  minio:
    image: ${MINIO_IMAGE}
    entrypoint: sh
    # Creates the `langfuse` bucket before the server starts.
    command:
      -c 'mkdir -p /data/langfuse && minio server --address ":9000" /data'
    environment:
      MINIO_ROOT_USER: minio
      MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD: [REDACTED]}
    volumes:
      - minio_data:/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "mc", "ready", "local"]
      interval: 2s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 60

volumes:
  postgres_data:
  clickhouse_data:
  clickhouse_logs:
  redis_data:
  minio_data:
